user_story:
As a user, I want to interact with buttons on the Buttons page to verify their functionality, such as clicking, double-clicking, and right-clicking, so that I can ensure they behave as expected.

Acceptance Criteria:
1. When I click the button with the ID 'sp5Bi', I should see a visible change on the page.
2. When I double-click the button with the ID 'doubleClickBtn', I should see a visible change on the page.
3. When I right-click the button with the ID 'rightClickBtn', I should see a visible change on the page.
